headline: Global Stocks Tumble Amid Technology Sell-Off and Market Volatility
summary: Global stock markets suffered sharp losses and Asia-Pacific markets slid following a Wall Street rout driven by a tech sell-off, though most indices remain positive for the year.
why: Broad equity sell-offs and volatility in major technology indices like the Nasdaq Composite impact investor sentiment, portfolio allocations, and broader macroeconomic risk assessments.
why_moved: Global equity markets fell sharply as investors reacted to intensifying panic in the technology sector following a significant Wall Street downturn.
